name: Job board
looksLike: a site with job openings and application links
a website to filter vacancies by location and role
a list of employers looking for new staff
definition: A website that organizes job opportunities so candidates can search by relevant criteria, review requirements and terms, and find a clear application route.
goal: Help candidates find suitable openings and apply.
audience: Job seekers and employers advertising roles

sections.name: Find a role
sections.purpose: Offer useful role, location, and work-arrangement filters.

sections.name: Vacancies
sections.purpose: Show consistent role and employer summaries.

sections.name: Role details
sections.purpose: Explain responsibilities, requirements, and disclosed terms.

sections.name: Apply and follow up
sections.purpose: Make the application method and expected next step clear.

mustHave: Current vacancies and clear employer identity
Transparent role location and work arrangement

prompts.short: Build a job board with useful filters, clear vacancy details, employer information, and application links.
prompts.detailed: Build a job board website for job seekers and employers advertising roles. Help candidates find suitable openings and apply. Include find a role, vacancies, role details, apply and follow up. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Current vacancies and clear employer identity.
